shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- spec ---' && sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && printf '%s\\n' '--- dod ---' && if test -f .lore/dod.md; then sed -n '1,220p' .lore/dod.md; else echo '(missing)'; fi && printf '%s\\n' '--- test commands ---' && sed -n '1,240p' .lore/test-commands.yml && printf '%s\\n' '--- package ---' && sed -n '1,220p' package.json && printf '%s\\n' '--- orchestrator ---' && sed -n '1,280p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts && printf '%s\\n' '--- existing orchestrator tests ---' && sed -n '1,320p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- acceptance examples ---' && rg --files | rg '\\.acceptance\\.test\\.(ts|tsx|js)"'$'"' | xargs -r -n1 sh -c 'echo --- "'$0; sed -n "1,220p" "$0"'"' && printf '%s\\n' '--- spec anchor usage ---' && rg -n \"specs/.*#|spec:|validated by\" src scripts specs .lore --glob '*.ts' --glob '*.md' --glob '*.yml' | sed -n '1,240p' && printf '%s\\n' '--- git status/log ---' && git status --short && git log --oneline -8 && printf '%s\\n' '--- git branches ---' && git branch -vv"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs && sed -n '1,260p' scripts/lore-run-test.mjs && rg -n \"spec anchor|specs/|@spec|spec:\" scripts src --glob '*.ts' --glob '*.mjs' | head -100 && git show origin/main:specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md | tail -30"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/orchestration/onError.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '20,90p'; nl -ba specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md | tail -20; git diff --check; git diff --stat"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git status --short && git diff -- src/orchestration/onError.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/onError.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && git commit -m "test: define onError non-Error rejection contract" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
